A single glance at the Index to Hotten's Lists of Emigrants will suffice to show that many Adams, Addams, Adamsons, or Addamsons were among the early settlers.
notes: Father of Hugh fil. Adam. Recorded as a patronymic - may not necessarily be nominative form
source: Hundred Rolls, 1273
record_text: Hugh fil. Adam, co. Oxf., ibid.
